official.deadline_note: The 2027 round opens on 1 December 2026 and closes on 15 March 2027. The Fund notes that updated scholarship-application information is announced on the programme page every January.
official.application_cycle: 2027 intake (applications 1 December 2026 - 15 March 2027); Fall semester admission only
official.status_note: The programme page announces: 'The 2027 TaiwanICDF Scholarship applications open from December 1, 2026 to March 15, 2027!'
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: the International Higher Education Scholarship Program 'offers full scholarships to outstanding students from partner countries to pursue higher education in Taiwan'; the itemised scope is published separately in the Fund's Scope of Scholarship and Application Guidebook documents.
benefits: Full scholarship to pursue higher education in Taiwan through collaborations with local universities
Study place at a partner university in the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance (TICA) network, established with partner universities since 1998
No age limit - the Fund states every applicant is evaluated comprehensively across all positive features
eligibility: National of a country listed by the Fund as an eligible beneficiary country; applicants from non-beneficiary countries cannot apply
Taiwanese (local) students are not eligible - the Fund provides these scholarships only to partner and other developing countries
Apply to one programme at one TICA partner university; one programme per year only
Must complete the partner university's own admission procedures in addition to the Fund's application
Must submit required documents to a Republic of China embassy, consulate general or representative office in their country where necessary
Bachelor's programmes are restricted to applicants from countries that maintain diplomatic relations with Taiwan
Prior holders of a TaiwanICDF scholarship, an MOFA Taiwan Scholarship or an MOE scholarship must have graduated before the Fund's stated cut-off before re-applying
requirements: Complete the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System in full, with accurate and complete information; failure to do so results in the application not being processed
Fulfil the application procedures required by the university applied to
Choose exactly one programme at one TICA partner university
selection_criteria: The Fund selects through a holistic assessment of all positive features of an applicant; there is no single threshold, and the Fund states there is no age limit
coverage: Full scholarship covering study in Taiwan at a TICA partner university and programme, as described by the Fund; the itemised scope (fees, monthly allowance and other items) is set out in the Fund's Scope of Scholarship document
application_method: Apply through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System between 1 December 2026 and 15 March 2027
Apply to the chosen TICA partner university and meet its admission requirements
Submit documents to the Republic of China embassy, consulate general or representative office where necessary
Only the Fund's acceptance letter confirms a scholarship award - university admission alone does not confer it
official.application_route: Apply online through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System (1 December 2026 - 15 March 2027) and separately complete the chosen TICA university's own admission procedure.
official.study_mode: Full-time higher-education study (bachelor's, master's or PhD) at a TICA partner university in Taiwan; Fall semester intake
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be nationals of countries listed by the Fund as eligible beneficiary countries; local Taiwanese students are not eligible
official.international_eligibility: Open to outstanding students from the Fund's partner countries and other developing countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: One programme at one TICA partner university per year, chosen from the list of programmes available for application published by the Fund
official.duration: Fixed duration set by the funded programme; the Fund states the scholarship cannot be extended and any additional study must be paid for by the scholar
official.description: The TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program offers full scholarships to outstanding students from partner countries to pursue higher education in Taiwan through collaborations with local universities under the Taiwan International Cooperation Alliance, supporting the socio-economic growth of partner countries through the cultivation of highly talented individuals.
official.program_type: Government scholarship administered by the International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF)

documents - the exact document list is published in the Application Guidebook, not on the pages read
verification.notes: The TaiwanICDF programme page, the Apply Now page and the Fund's scholarship FAQ were read on 2026-10-10; the 2027 window of 1 December 2026 - 15 March 2027, the 'full scholarships' framing, the one-programme-per-university rule, the holistic no-age-limit selection and the acceptance-letter-only confirmation were all confirmed on icdf.org.tw.

applicant_utility.summary: The 2027 window is short - 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027 - and admission to a TICA university is not the scholarship: only the Fund's own acceptance letter confirms the award, so you must run the university's admission process and the Fund's application in parallel. Choose exactly one programme at one partner university for the year, because a second choice is not possible, and check that your country sits on the Fund's eligible list before investing in documents. The Fund publishes no English-test requirement of its own, but the partner university's admission rules still apply to you.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants from TaiwanICDF partner/developing countries who want a full scholarship for a bachelor's, master's or PhD at a TICA partner university and can commit to a Fall semester start.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country is on the Fund's eligible beneficiary list before preparing anything else
Shortlist one programme at one TICA university from the Fund's 'Programs Available for Application' list - the one-programme-per-year rule leaves no room for hedging
Start the partner university's admission procedure at the same time; scholarship consideration does not exempt you from it
Download the current TaiwanICDF Scholarship Application Guidebook from the Apply Now page for the exact document list
Submit required documents to the ROC embassy, consulate or representative office in your country where the guidebook requires it
Enter complete, accurate information in the online system - the Fund warns incomplete applications are not processed
For bachelor's, verify your country maintains diplomatic relations with Taiwan before applying
common_rejection_risks: Treating university admission as scholarship confirmation - only the Fund's acceptance letter awards the scholarship
Submitting incomplete or inaccurate information in the online system, which the Fund says stops processing altogether
Applying from a country outside the Fund's eligible list
Applying to a bachelor's programme from a country without diplomatic relations with Taiwan
Re-applying as a previous TaiwanICDF, MOFA Taiwan or MOE scholarship holder without having graduated before the Fund's cut-off
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not published on the web pages; the itemised scope (what the monthly allowance and fee coverage do and do not include) is in the Fund's Scope of Scholarship document, and the Fund warns any study beyond the scholarship duration must be self-funded.
document_audit: The document list lives in the Application Guidebook PDF, not on the programme page - download the current edition rather than relying on older copies
Where the ROC representative office must receive documents, build mailing time into the 1 December - 15 March window
One programme at one university per year is a hard rule, so transcripts and certificates cannot be recycled across multiple applications in the same round
alerts: The round opens 1 December 2026 and closes 15 March 2027 - a roughly 15-week window that spans year-end holidays in many countries
The Fund notes updated application information is announced on the programme page every January, so re-check after opening
The scholarship cannot be extended; anything beyond the funded duration is paid by the scholar
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Online application through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System, parallel admission at the chosen TICA university, with documents to the ROC representative office where required, and the Fund's acceptance letter as the sole confirmation.
